mapper.sql: id, channel, external_user_id, email, platform_user_id, draw_date, usage_window_start, usage_window_end, eligible_usage, payout_ratio, multiplier, reward_amount, status, idempotency_key, failure_reason, created_at, credited_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM bot_lottery_draws ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bot_lottery_draws ( channel, external_user_id, email, platform_user_id, draw_date, usage_window_start, usage_window_end, eligible_usage, payout_ratio, multiplier, reward_amount, status, idempotency_key, failure_reason, created_at, credited_at ) VALUES ( #{channel}, #{externalUserId}, #{email}, #{platformUserId}, #{drawDate}, #{usageWindowStart}, #{usageWindowEnd}, #{eligibleUsage}, #{payoutRatio}, #{multiplier}, #{rewardAmount}, #{status}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{failureReason}, now(), #{creditedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE bot_lottery_draws SET status = 'CREDITED', credited_at = #{creditedAt}, failure_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bot_lottery_draws SET status = 'FAILED', failure_reason = #{failureReason}, credited_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE bot_lottery_draws SET status = 'NO_PRIZE', credited_at = NULL, failure_reason = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
